name: Generate image of ODF
summary: Renders PNG images of fibre orientation distribution functions (ODFs) from CSD spherical-harmonic coefficients for a chosen sub-volume, using DIPY visualisation.
description: Loads the CSD FOD of the selected lmax, converts the spherical harmonics in the requested x/y/z slice ranges to ODFs on a 724-point sphere and renders them with DIPY/VTK (off-screen) as images for visual quality control. Use it to check that CSD fits look plausible, e.g. crossing fibres in the centrum semiovale; slice ranges must lie within the image.

inputs.description: Constrained spherical deconvolution FODs (one file per lmax).

outputs.description: PNG images of the ODFs in the selected sub-volume.

parameters.description: Spherical harmonic order of the FOD to plot (selects the lmax<N> file of the csd input).
Scale factor for the size of the rendered ODF glyphs.
Start and end voxel indices along x of the region to render (two space-separated integers).
Start and end voxel indices along y of the region to render (two space-separated integers).
Start and end voxel indices along z of the region to render (two space-separated integers).
